messages.subject: For Anders Danielsson | Infrastructure, sustainability and government stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Skanska Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Anders Danielsson, President and Chief Executive Officer.

Skanska's global infrastructure and development portfolio depends on disciplined alignment across governments, communities, sustainability commitments and operating teams. That interface closely matches the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate complex cross-functional stakeholder matters.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and infrastructure stakeholder strategy might support Skanska's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Skanska.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
